title: Billing and Coding: Peripheral Nerve Injections and Procedures for Chronic Pain

codes.2: *64999 is to be used to report injections of anesthetic and/or steroids for the facial and phrenic nerves and cervical plexus. This code replaces the deleted codes 64402, 64410 and 64413.
codes.3: Do not report 64454 in conjunction with 64624 Do not report 64625 in conjunction with 77002, 77012, 95873 or 95874

covered.3: Genicular nerve block and RFA- CPT® codes 64454, 64624
covered.4: Plantar common digital nerve (e.g. Morton’s neuroma)- CPT ® code 64455
covered.5: Greater occipital nerve block - CPT ® code 64405
covered.8: The following CPT ® codes are non-covered for pain management: 64430*, 64632*, 64420, 64421, 64620, 64450, 64640, 64999, 0440T, 0441T and 0442T . Use of therapeutic nerve blocks not listed but not included in coverage (Paragraphs 1-7 above) are non-covered for pain management. When applicable, any specific device used to perform the procedure must be listed in the comments section of the claim. That with * is permitted a single diagnostic injection but subsequent injections are subject to denial. Use for peri or post-operative anesthesia is excluded from non-coverage
